d: COSEC PATH DCFE is a fingerprint-based access control device supporting up to 50,000 users and 500,000 event logs, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth (BLE), Ethernet, and PoE (IEEE 802.3af) for flexible network connectivity and easy installation, IP65-rated rugged design, high-accuracy fingerprint sensor (0.001% FAR), and supports fingerprint, mobile, and RFID card authentication

specs.label: Max. Template Storage
specs.value: 25,000 in 1: N Mode and 100,000 in 1:1 Mode

specs.label: Templates per User
specs.value: Up to 10 (Single Template per Finger Mode); Up to 5 (Dual Template per Finger Mode)
